scope: Real-history migration, guarded lightweight routing replay, and native AC-WM batch adapter for the demo-video factory
summary: Migrated 30 immutable real-input Ego repair candidates into six complete factory episodes, trained and held-action-group evaluated the unified ridge router, and correctly rejected promotion at 0% acceptance. Added a provenance-complete native AC-WM worker plus a strict campaign builder that requires two independent licensed sources before a new GPU bootstrap can run.
evidence: outputs/demo-factory-history-import/20260811T151158Z-4f2960eb/manifest.json records 30 candidates, six episodes, three held action groups, five recipes, and dataset SHA-256 47ee3fcc0aa1ff069d9840f486706d3b52227a4aca1888eef707a9edb392bde3.

outputs/demo-factory-router-real-history/20260811T151204Z-256a5d8e/held-group-evaluation.json reports promoted=false, learned acceptance_rate=0.0, mean_attempts=5.0, mean_cost_units=5.0, and selected_non_regression_rate=1.0.
The acceptance, attempt, capability, cost, and utility non-regression gates passed; the absolute minimum acceptance-rate gate failed.

scripts/run_acwm_demo_factory_worker.py preserves the native trace/video under the immutable attempt and binds license, source hash, coordinate frame, generator revision, evaluator revision, physical GPU, and human-review input.
scripts/build_acwm_demo_factory_campaign.py rejects same-source bootstrap groups and emits a complete raw/identity/object/temporal recipe tournament.
Nine focused CPU tests and targeted Ruff checks pass after the adapter and campaign-builder additions.
agentic_skills/evolve-demo-video-factory passes skill-creator quick validation after the fail-closed AC-WM workflow update.
lessons: Historical generated videos can train failure ranking only if their original metrics, hashes, and pending human decisions are preserved without relabeling.
Non-regression against a failing baseline is necessary but insufficient; an absolute acceptance floor prevents a router from being promoted when every recipe remains unusable.
Held action labels from one source interval do not establish held-scene generalization and must not be presented as independent scene groups.
Batch scale requires explicit source rights, content hashes, coordinate frames, generator/evaluator revisions, and human review before GPU work begins.
limitations: All 30 migrated candidates come from one EPIC-KITCHENS source interval and every historical human review is pending.
The real-history router produced no accepted candidates and no distillation preference rows, so no policy or planner was promoted.
The new AC-WM adapter and campaign builder have CPU protocol tests but have not yet completed a two-scene GPU tournament.
Cost units in the history replay are candidate counts, not measured GPU seconds or currency.
next_actions: Prepare at least two independent licensed AC-WM case manifests with source and condition hashes, pinned generator/evaluator revisions, explicit action frames, and human-review files.
Run the four-recipe GPU bootstrap through scripts/run_demo_factory_batch.py and append both failures and accepted outcomes.
Train a router only after complete two-scene tournaments exist, then require a fresh held-scene production acceptance and cost result before promotion.
Export planner-distillation rows only from guarded chosen/rejected pairs and evaluate any small adapter against the same frozen gates.
